name: Warming up in the Snowstorm
source:
You get caught in a snowstorm on your way back from working late and your car breaks down before you can make it home. Looking for some sort of shelter you find two deer kind enough to help you out- Rudolph and Clarice. At first you're just glad to be safe but being so close causes things to get a bit heated.

[From [url=https://deanwolfwood.itch.io/warming-up-in-the-snowstorm]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
加班到深夜后，你在回家途中遭遇暴风雪，车子还没到家就抛了锚。寻找避难处时，你遇见两位愿意伸出援手的鹿——鲁道夫和克拉丽丝。起初，能平安脱险就足以让你庆幸，但近距离的相处，渐渐让气氛热了起来。

[摘自[url=https://deanwolfwood.itch.io/warming-up-in-the-snowstorm]Itch.io[/url]]
